name: myself-dashboard
description: MySelf Research Dashboard — secure monitoring, completeness, review and export for the MySelf survey

scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-myself-dashboard --config firebase.emulators.json "node scripts/emulator-setup.mjs && playwright test"
scripts.e2e:build: pnpm --filter @myself-dashboard/core build && pnpm --filter @myself-dashboard/functions build && pnpm --filter @myself-dashboard/web build:emulators
